# WorKraken UI reference

Source: `Workraken/WorKraken-web`, commit `59c900cbeb9135b0a282f3311d9598ff8e9e4d93`.

These are the original production CSS files, loaded in the order used by `webapp/templates/base.html`. Only local asset URL roots were relocated to `/vendor/workraken`; no declarations, colors, sizes or components were redesigned. `provenance.json` records each original and output SHA-256.

The football app supplies its own content and controller. No business records, credentials, source templates or backend code are included.
